evals.prompt: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000 in Chromium, wait for the element with data-testid=dashboard to become visible, save a full-page screenshot to dashboard.png in the user workspace, and do not overwrite an existing image.
evals.expected_output: A full-page Chromium screenshot after the requested dashboard element becomes visible, or an explicit skipped status when the output already exists.
expectations: The bundled browser_snapshot.py script is used with the explicit local URL.
The workflow waits for [data-testid='dashboard'] and requests a full-page screenshot.
Existing output is not overwritten without --overwrite.

evals.prompt: Inspect https://example.com in a real browser. Report the rendered page title and visible text from main, and return structured JSON without creating a screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Structured JSON containing the requested URL, final URL, title, and visible text scoped to main.
expectations: The browser snapshot workflow uses --selector main and --json.
The result distinguishes the requested URL from the final URL after redirects.

evals.prompt: Test the login form on the local app URL that I provided. Enter the synthetic account test-user@example.test, submit it, and verify that the page navigates to /dashboard and shows a heading named Dashboard. Do not use arbitrary sleeps or read cookies from my installed browsers.
evals.expected_output: A focused Playwright interaction using synthetic data, resilient locators, explicit URL and heading checks, and an isolated browser context.
expectations: The workflow uses accessible Playwright locators where possible.
The workflow waits for and asserts the requested URL and visible heading instead of sleeping blindly.
The workflow does not inspect browser profiles or cookies.
